log.text: 596 tests pass in 13.5 seconds, no failures.

The landing page told Intel owners the app runs on their Mac. build-app.sh runs swift build -c release, which builds for the host only, so the 1.0.1 image is arm64 and would not launch. The page now says Apple silicon. A universal binary is the real fix and is not cut.
Landing page cut down: 63 feature descriptions removed, leaving the names and their shortcuts, and the four highlight cards dropped because every one of them repeated an entry in the lists below.

1.0.1 notarised by Apple. The first launch is now an ordinary double-click — no right-click, no warning. Signed with a Developer ID, so a permission granted once survives an update instead of being asked for again.

Bug sweep finished: all 38 issues closed. Seven were data loss — a failed move losing both copies, a replaced folder vanishing rather than going to the Trash, swift test rewriting the real theme.json.

Semantic index rebuilt: nested roots no longer double their passages each pass, the incremental keep is linear rather than quadratic, and folder scoping compares paths instead of string prefixes so ~/Notes-archive is not inside ~/Notes.

One theme system. theme.json is the only file that stores colours; the ready-made palettes are constants that write into it, and which one is in force is derived by comparing colours rather than recorded. The .soquel-theme format and the import/export around it are gone.
